sentences.text:
HIGH COURT OF CHHATTISGARH, BILASPUR  MCRC No. 5945 of 2023   Shriniwas Patel S/o Chandramani Prasad Patel, Aged About 35 Years R/o  Sanjaypara, Bhairamgarh, Police Station - Bhairamgarh, District : Bijapur,
 Chhattisgarh

---- Applican  Versus   State Of Chhattisgarh Through - Station House Officer, Police Station -  Bhairamgarh, District : Bijapur, Chhattisgarh  ---- Respondent For Applicant - Mr. Amitesh Kumar Pandey, Advocate For State - Mr. Anil Tripathi, P.L. Hon'ble Shri Justice Deepak Kumar Tiwari Order on Board 18.08.2023 1.

This is the first bail application filed under Section 439 of Cr.P.C. for grant of regular bail to the applicant, who has been arrested in connection with Crime No. 14/2023 registered in Police Station Bhairamgarh Distt. Bijapur Chhattisgarh for offence punishable under Sections 376, 450 of Indian Penal Code and Section 4(1) of POCSO Act.

entities.text: Police Station Bhairamgarh Distt. Bijapur Chhattisgarh
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: 2. As per the prosecution case, the applicant has forcefully committed sexual intercourse with the minor prosecutrix and based on such allegation, the aforesaid offence has been registered.
3. Learned counsel for the applicant would submit that the applicant is innocent and has been falsely implicated in the crime in question for which, he is in jail since 20.04.2023.

He submits that the FIR has been lodged belatedly and considering the said aspects, the applicant may be enlarged on bail.
4.
The prosecutrix has appeared through video conferencing from concerned DLSA and has categorically supported the case of prosecution.

5. Per contra, learned State counsel opposes the bail application and submits that as the prosecutrix has supported the case of prosecution, therefore the present is not a fit case to grant bail to the applicant.

6. Considered the submission of parties and perused statement of prosecutrix raising objection for grant of bail before the Court below and also considering the allegation which is serious in nature,
this Court is not inclined to release the applicant on bail.
Accordingly, the bail application is rejected.
7. However, this Court hopes and trusts that the concerned Court below shall expedite the trial.
